subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Among Stars and Shadows
email_body:
Hi Diane,

I came across Among Stars and Shadows, the first book in your Encantraalm saga, and the idea of Kayla falling for an elven prince while his own father threatens the human realm caught my attention. Following it with Beneath Thorns and Ashes gives readers a full world to step into.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author.

Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for Among Stars and Shadows is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Among Stars and Shadows best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
